orientation: Labeling and logging are separate checks: inspect the container and the intake register independently.

concepts.name: labeled sample
non_features: A blank label does not satisfy labeling
Register presence alone does not prove labeling

concepts.name: logged sample
defining_features: Sample ID is recorded in the intake register
non_features: Labeling alone does not prove logging
Absence from the register does not satisfy logging

boundary_cases.case: V7 bears V7 and is recorded in the register
boundary_cases.classification: both labeled sample and logged sample

boundary_cases.case: V8 has a blank label but is recorded as V8
boundary_cases.basis: The register satisfies logging; the blank label fails labeling.

recognition_cues: Does the container bear its own sample ID?
Is that sample ID recorded in the intake register?

evidence.claim: V8 is logged but not labeled.
evidence.source_input: Boundary case states a blank label and a V8 register entry.

unresolved_ambiguities: A case can satisfy both concepts, so they are not exclusive.
Whether every sample must satisfy at least one concept is not supplied; neither remains possible.
Therefore an either-or discriminating question is unsupported.
